title: Backbone Integration, Portability and Gated-Work Readiness Handoff
objective: Integrate the entire MIB program and leave unavailable future work cheaper, safer and more mechanical without performing gated deployment, distribution, provider activation or blocked reconstruction.

scope.purpose: Integrate the entire MIB program and leave unavailable future work cheaper, safer and more mechanical.
deliverables: cross-MIB integration fixture and validation profile
portable test/evidence package for future Mac/Apple and hosted-provider environments
distribution/tester-environment readiness checklist without performing distribution
T04/WP-011/DS-008 boundary map showing what MIB can pre-satisfy and what still requires the missing condition
future implementation handoff map identifying remaining true external blockers versus ordinary implementation work
scope.completion_gate: The backbone passes exact-head repository health, self-hosted Windows/Linux and deterministic comparison where applicable; blocked/gated work has explicit portable inputs and no MIB tranche leaves an undocumented shared primitive or one-off duplicate foundation.

selection_boundaries: MIB-17 is completed_verified and its implementation authority is retired.
MIB-18 is selected_not_started only until a subsequent owner Continue governed-starts this attempt.
MIB-18 must integrate ARI into its compatibility/integration matrix and portability/readiness handoff while preserving interfaces for later SAA work.

CCTI-12-T04, WP-011, DS-008 blocked reconstruction, tester distribution/public deployment, paid-provider activation and unavailable platform/provider work remain gated by their own missing conditions.
MIB-18 must not create competing local registry/index/runtime/adapter/component foundations instead of consuming completed shared MIB primitives.
SMB-01 is the next planned family work item after MIB-18/program closure and remains unauthorized until MIB-18 is completed_verified and the family transition is reconciled.
next_action: On the next owner Continue, governed-start MIB-18 under the product-development lane, establish its bounded implementation branch and acceptance seam, then execute through exact-head validation and MIB family closure before selecting SMB-01.
